title: The Knight Picks h6
setup: Black has just attacked the knight on f7 with a rook, while the queen on c4 eyes the a2–g8 diagonal.
hint: Your knight stands on the queen's diagonal, so any knight move checks twice — choose its landing square carefully.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nh6+}} is a double check, so the rook cannot capture and the king must move: {{Kh8}} is its only square. Now {{Qg8+}} forces {{Rxg8}}, and {{Nf7#}} smothers it. The knight had to choose h6 so that it would guard g8 for the sacrifice.
